summary: P131 added: The writer is a plain Claude Code session, and scripts verify around it -- Every task's writer runs as a headless top-level Claude Code session the drive launches on plain's own prompt, on a model pinned by full id at high effort, under a per-session budget, priced by the session's own total_cost_usd, and returning one JSON answer per acceptance clause. After the session th [truncated]
P131.1 added to P131: Tests and the two lint modules leave the shipped plugin: plugins/audit/tests/ becomes tests/, _deps and _refs become tools/lints/
P131.2 added to P131: The rest of the development code leaves the plugin, the selftest stubs go, and B9 is recorded
P131.3 added to P131: One script runs a writer or a reviewer as a headless top-level session under a per-session budget and prints its cost from the session's own result
P131.4 added to P131: The writer's prompt is plain's own prompt, composed from the task by script, with one closing line asking for an answer per acceptance clause
P131.5 added to P131: The drive dispatches the writer through the session runner on the plain prompt, and a red task gate resumes the session that wrote the task
P131.6 added to P131: After a writer session the drive proves red-first through git, locks the test digest, takes the stamp and files the return itself
P131.7 added to P131: Every acceptance clause has an answer before a task closes, and a clause with no answer resumes the writer instead of passing in silence
P131.8 added to P131: A reviewer session that opened no file is not accepted as a review
P131.9 added to P131: A phase-review finding blocks only after a second pass validates it, and a validated finding goes back to the writer's session while it is warm
P131.10 added to P131: Red-first on an inline suite pulls in the imports and helpers the applied test hunks reference, so a new case goes red on its assertion rather than on a NameError
P131.11 added to P131: The release followers and the release commit take the pinned-example paths from the one reader that checks them, so a new pinned example is repinned with no edit to release.py
P131.12 added to P131: A task gate's open-high-bugs condition exempts the bugs its own task and that phase's open sibling tasks are fixing, while sign-off and the release guard still count every one
P131.13 added to P131: A fix task made at triage derives its gate only from the suite paths among the finding's files, and takes the phase gate when none is a suite
P131.14 added to P131: The low findings carried from BF4: CI check names without the image, a block-list matrix axis read by gate-parity, and a history sentence in ci.yml corrected
